desc.optimization.profile: Optimization preset: lossless visuals, balanced performance, or maximum FPS
desc.optimization.autoCompatibility: Automatically yields overlapping hooks when Sodium, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, or similar mods are loaded
desc.optimization.undergroundCaveCulling: Skips sealed zero-skylight underground cave sections while you are above ground
desc.optimization.retainedTerrainCache: Reuses prepared visible chunk draw lists and cached terrain buffers in normal worlds
desc.optimization.leafCulling: Culls hidden interior faces between adjacent leaf blocks
desc.optimization.fastModelRendering: Fast batch vertex submission for entity models and block quads
desc.optimization.occlusionCulling: Hides mobs and containers occluded behind solid walls
desc.optimization.staticBlockEntityBatch: Batches static chests, ender chests, skulls, pots, and sign boards into retained GPU buffers
desc.optimization.staticEntityBatching: Batches armor stands, item frames, and stationary mobs into retained GPU buffers
desc.optimization.hologramTextCache: Caches world hologram, sign, and label glyph geometry to avoid rebuilding text every frame
desc.optimization.emptyBlockEntitySkip: Skips rendering pass for empty campfires and lecterns without books
desc.optimization.signTextCulling: Hides sign text facing away from the camera or beyond the chosen distance
desc.optimization.signTextDistance: Maximum distance in blocks at which sign text is rendered
desc.optimization.itemClustering: Caps identical dropped items and XP orbs rendered per block cell
desc.optimization.itemClusterLimit: Maximum identical dropped items or XP orbs drawn in a single 1x1x1 block
desc.optimization.nametagCulling: Hides distant nametags and caps dense crowds; close and glowing players always stay visible
desc.optimization.nametagDistance: Maximum distance in blocks at which nametags are rendered
desc.optimization.entityCulling: Skips non-player entities beyond the chosen distance; glowing entities stay visible
desc.optimization.entityDistance: Maximum render distance in blocks for non-player entities
desc.optimization.blockEntityCulling: Skips block entity renderers beyond the chosen distance
desc.optimization.blockEntityDistance: Maximum render distance in blocks for block entities
desc.optimization.particleCulling: Caps active particles, filters by distance, and deduplicates dense block cells
desc.optimization.particleDistance: Maximum distance in blocks for spawning particles
desc.optimization.particleLimit: Maximum active particle count before new distant particles are skipped
desc.optimization.fastParticlePhysics: Skips expensive block collision checks for particles farther than 6 blocks
desc.optimization.hudCache: Reuses retained NightClient HUD frames instead of rebuilding every frame
desc.optimization.vanillaHudCache: Reuses cached GPU draw buffers for hotbar, hearts, chat, and scoreboard between game ticks
desc.optimization.scoreboardCache: Caches vanilla scoreboard layout and formatted text per game tick
desc.optimization.nativeGpuInstancing: Accelerates dynamic entities, players, and 3D holograms using nightclient-native GPU batching (compatible with Sodium)
desc.optimization.nativePboUploads: Uploads player skins, custom heads, and dynamic textures asynchronously via native PBO buffers
desc.optimization.nativePacketCodec: Accelerates multiplayer packet compression and decompression using the native library
